title: After the Japanese Derby: Standing Tall

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe dominates at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her win comes at the cost of great stress on her body. Agnes Tachyon and I spare no effort in nursing her back to health…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Managing to prevent Manhattan Cafe from suffering any serious issues, we hold out hope for the autumn season.
